info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Medicals-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Medical Records API provides access to the medical information of pets available for adoption. This API allows users to retrieve detailed health records, vaccination statuses, and medical histories of various pets, ensuring potential adopters have the necessary information to make informed decisions. Ideal for veterinarians, animal shelters, and pet adoption agencies, this API streamlines the process of sharing essential pet health data among stakeholders. Enhance the adoption experience by offering transparency and fostering trust between pets and their potential new families.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the medical records associated with their pets. Users can gain insights into vaccinations, treatments, and any other medical history for their registered pets.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve medical information about pets. It should include relevant parameters to specify the type of medical data being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved medical information for pets.
